title: When a Form D must be amended
rule: An issuer may amend a Form D at any time. It must amend to correct a material mistake, to reflect most changes in the information filed, and every year on or before the anniversary of its last filing while the offering continues. Some changes need no amendment, including amounts sold, investor counts, a lower offering amount, and an increase in the offering amount of 10% or less. Every amendment restates all items with current information.
changeWatch: Amendments to Rule 503 or new staff interpretations in Section 130.
